meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把图片转成文字与版面结构,让看不见图的模型也能读
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的模型看不了图,却常要它读截图和图表
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into structured text so text-only models can read them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your model can't see images but you keep asking it to read them

howto.what: 当对话里出现图片路径、URL 或贴图占位符而 Claude 看不到内容时，它会改用 modlens CLI 把图片转成结构化 JSON：逐字转录、版式区域、语义与视觉线索，再据此回答。
howto.when: 当对话中出现带图片扩展名的路径/URL、`[Image #1]` 等贴图占位符，且 Claude 看不到图时接管；若模型本身能看图则不用。

say.note: modlens 转成 JSON 证据后作答

say.text: 帮我配置 modlens 的 Gemini API key
跑一下 modlens guard，看当前模型能不能自己看图
say.note: 会话首次读图前先判定

howto.what_en: When an image path, URL, or pasted-image placeholder appears and Claude cannot see the image, it runs the modlens CLI to turn it into structured JSON evidence (transcript, layout, semantics) and answers from that.
howto.when_en: Hard rule: when an image path/URL, a `[Image #1]` placeholder, or a `[Image: source: <path>]` line appears and Claude can't see it, this skill takes over. Skip if the model sees images natively.

say_en.text: Help me set up modlens with a Gemini API key
say_en.note: Writes the key via config set

say_en.text: Run modlens guard for the current model
say_en.note: Tells you if the model reads images itself
